name: Floating Point Group
rootCause: Floating Point Group reported a cyber incident on June 11, 2023, with industry estimates of $15,20 million lost. Incident aggregators classify the attack as a frontend and infrastructure compromise, but no confirmed technical exploit sequence, compromised credential type, or blockchain evidence is available. The cause is not independently established. Catalogues classify the incident as involving compromise of sensitive operational keys through infrastructure or frontend failure, but technical details, credential type, and workflow are not disclosed by the company or its partners.
